description: Post-lowering AST conformance for the mom6_cgrid momentum rule set (grids/mom6_cgrid/rules/mom6_cgrid_vort_x/y.esm, mom6_cgrid_grad_x/y.esm, mom6_cgrid_avg_u/v.esm, mom6_cgrid_avg_cell.esm, mom6_cgrid_sum_q.esm, mom6_cgrid_mask2dBu.esm, mom6_cgrid_pvf_u/v.esm, mom6_cgrid_bound_coriolis_u/v.esm) at N_I = N_J = 8, N_K = 3 — the traced stage-2 subdomain of the EqESM MOM6 momentum lane. Pins the canonical expanded bytes of the full Coriolis + relative-vorticity + KE-gradient law chain of CorAdCalc (MOM_CoriolisAdv.F90:322-357, gradKE :1249-1397, SADOURNY75_ENERGY :897-955, bound_coriolis :897-925/:1139-1150): the ground per-variable D-rule expansions (D(v,x)/D(u,y) with the dyCv/dxCu-weighted forward differences and their explicit free-slip 0 east/north wall regions, D(KE,x)/D(KE,y) with the IdxCu/IdyCv-scaled gradients and 0 walls), the q-point mask product rule with its explicit 0 walls, the 0.5 face averages and the 0.25 cell average with zero west/south wall terms, the q-cell corner sum with zero land faces beyond the east/north walls, the raw PV fluxes and the bound_coriolis min/max clamps with zero wall-face and land-face fluxes/velocities (MOM6's closed-basin values), and the KE_ARAKAWA chain; the numeric correctness is verified by tests/conformance/simulation/mom6_cgrid_momentum and against the Fortran by the stage-2 mom6_momentum pins (EqESM stage2/mom6_momentum.esm).
